payload.description_html: Comparison of Dinosaurs size (scale diagram), featuring Argentinosaurus (36 meters), Spinosaurus (18 meters), Edmontosaurus (12 meters), Stegosaurus (10 meters) and Triceratops (9 meters). Based on drawings by Nobu Tamura ( https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Triceratops_BW.jpg , https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spinosaurus_BW2.png , https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stegosaurus_BW.jpg , https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anatotitan_BW.jpg ) and Zachi Evenor ( https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Argentinosaurus-ZE-001.png ).
